say:0:1360211001:1.text: Following a fleeting flash, the ground begins to roil once more, revealing a familiar figure from within...
say:0:1360211001:1.source_cn: 一道光芒闪过，地面再次开始翻涌，从中呈现出了一个熟悉的...

say:1:1360211002:1.text: *Cough, cough*... I'm finally free. Thank you, everyone.
say:1:1360211002:1.source_cn: 咳、咳咳，总算脱困了，多谢各位。

say:2:1360211003:1.text: I was so distressed seeing you talk to my doppelganger, but I couldn't stop you.
say:2:1360211003:1.source_cn: 刚刚看到你们与那个影子伪装成的我对话，我十分焦急，却无...

say:3:1360211004:1.text: Thankfully, you were sharp enough to see through him!
say:3:1360211004:1.source_cn: 还好你们反应及时，没有被那家伙欺骗！

choice_prompt:4:1360211004.text: Thankfully, you were sharp enough to see through him!
choice_prompt:4:1360211004.source_cn: 还好你们反应及时，没有被那家伙欺骗！

say:6:1360211005:1.text: That's right! I didn't notice anything unusual at all! It was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who gave me the heads-up!
say:6:1360211005:1.source_cn: 是的，我完全没发现有什么异常，还是<style=str...
say:6:1360211005:1.male: That's right! I didn't notice anything unusual at all! It was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who gave me the heads-up!
say:6:1360211005:1.female: That's right! I didn't notice anything unusual at all! It was <style="stress"><player_name></style> who gave me the heads-up!

say:7:1360211008:1.text: So, Mr. Faramor, would you mind telling us what you went through?
say:7:1360211008:1.source_cn: 那么，法拉莫尔先生，能告诉我们你到底遭遇了什么呢？

say:8:1360211009:1.text: I heard you were ambushed and got involved in a fight. Also, I detected corrupted magic.
say:8:1360211009:1.source_cn: 当时我听到的，是你被偷袭而后交战，同时还捕捉到了扭曲的气息。

say:9:1360211010:1.source_cn: 风语者啊，你们的能力我也久仰大名了。

say:10:1360211011:1.text: You're right—I was indeed ambushed, and it was you who attacked me.
say:10:1360211011:1.source_cn: 如你所说，我的确是遭到了偷袭，而偷袭我的人正是你。

say:12:1360211013:1.text: Y-You mean Berial, who disguised himself as me, right?
say:12:1360211013:1.source_cn: 你、你是说贝利尔伪装的我吧！

say:13:1360211014:0.text: Of course. Actually, it wasn't long before I caught onto the corrupt magic and confirmed that the man was anything but ordinary.
say:13:1360211014:0.source_cn: 当然，事实上，我在第一时间就察觉到了那扭曲的气息，并确...

choice_prompt:14:1360211014.text: Of course. Actually, it wasn't long before I caught onto the corrupt magic and confirmed that the man was anything but ordinary.
choice_prompt:14:1360211014.source_cn: 当然，事实上，我在第一时间就察觉到了那扭曲的气息，并确定眼前的人绝非常人。

say:15:1360211015:1.text: I-I noticed it right after your reminder! Guess I was a little slow...
say:15:1360211015:1.source_cn: 我、我在你提醒以后就发现了不对劲，虽然的确慢了一步吧……
say:15:1360211015:1.male: I-I noticed it right after your reminder! Guess I was a little slow...
say:15:1360211015:1.female: I-I noticed it right after your reminder! Guess I was a little slow...

say:16:1360211017:1.text: The one thing that confirmed my suspicions was the music he played.
say:16:1360211017:1.source_cn: 如果说一开始还只是怀疑，那么坚定我猜测的就是对方弹奏的琴音。

say:17:1360211018:1.text: The melody was warped and out of tune. Any creature that loves the jungle and life could do better than that.
say:17:1360211018:1.source_cn: 那声音参差扭曲，绝不是任何一个热爱丛林与生命的生灵会发...

say:18:1360211019:1.text: I put on an ignorant face, but when I probed him, he suddenly erupted into wild laughter.
say:18:1360211019:1.source_cn: 我装作没有发现异常，试探对方的时候，对方却突然狂笑起来。

say:19:1360211020:1.text: After that, I realized my shadow began to take shape. I was trapped, and my shadow turned into my doppelganger...
say:19:1360211020:1.source_cn: 然后，我发现我的影子扭曲着站起来，将我困住，而我的影子...

say:20:1360211021:1.text: Then we got here. Phew, I'm glad you weren't hurt!
say:20:1360211021:1.source_cn: 接下来就是我们抵达此处了，呼，太好了，还好你没受伤。

say:22:1360211022:0.text: I'm surprised Berial didn't just devour you. This is out of character for him.
say:22:1360211022:0.source_cn: 只是将人困住，以影子伪装，而没有直接吞噬或者侵蚀并取而...

say:23:1360211023:0.text: He said his shadow couldn't last much longer... Could his real body be somewhere else?
say:23:1360211023:0.source_cn: 刚刚他说过，自己的影子要耗尽了……会不会这里并非他的本体？

say:24:1360211024:0.text: It's possible. Berial's always unpredictable with his countless doppelgangers.
say:24:1360211024:0.source_cn: 的确，贝利尔向来千变万化，分身万千。

say:25:1360211025:0.text: If we're dealing with one of his doppelgangers, it'd explain why he showed mercy this time.
say:25:1360211025:0.source_cn: 如果此时我们面对的只是一个用于取乐的分身，就能够解释这...

say:26:1360211026:1.text: Doesn't that mean his real self is wreaking havoc elsewhere?
say:26:1360211026:1.source_cn: 但那样的话，岂不是他本体还在别处作恶？

say:27:1360211027:1.text: Or maybe his doppelgangers are the ones who caused the chaos in all those places!
say:27:1360211027:1.source_cn: 不，说不定各个地方都是他的分身搞出来的事情！

choice_prompt:28:1360211027.text: Or maybe his doppelgangers are the ones who caused the chaos in all those places!
choice_prompt:28:1360211027.source_cn: 不，说不定各个地方都是他的分身搞出来的事情！

say:29:1360211028:1.text: Hmm, I suppose so. Remember how he messes with Dunlingr? It shows that he cares more about having fun rather than actually achieving his goal.
say:29:1360211028:1.source_cn: 唔，确实。他故意拖延离开的时间，为了捉弄顿里尔大人，可...
say:29:1360211028:1.male: Hmm, I suppose so. Remember how he messes with Dunlingr? It shows that he cares more about having fun rather than actually achieving his goal.
say:29:1360211028:1.female: Hmm, I suppose so. Remember how he messes with Dunlingr? It shows that he cares more about having fun rather than actually achieving his goal.

say:30:1360211030:1.text: Berial's all about having fun. To spice things up, he might leave us some bait to lead us on... I mean, clues.
say:30:1360211030:1.source_cn: 一个喜欢追寻乐趣的家伙，为了更好玩，说不定会特意给我们...

say:31:1360211031:1.text: But what could the clues be?

say:32:1360211032:1.text: The first sign of trouble was the instruments going out of tune. From the victims' experiences, it's clear everything is linked to sound.
say:32:1360211032:1.source_cn: 最开始发现不对劲，是从乐器走音开始，其他受害者受到的影...

say:33:1360211033:1.text: Faramor said he saw through the doppelganger because of the distorted music it played...
say:33:1360211033:1.source_cn: 法拉莫尔还说过，他确定猜测，是因为对方扮成我在他面前弹...

choice_prompt:34:1360211033.text: Faramor said he saw through the doppelganger because of the distorted music it played...
choice_prompt:34:1360211033.source_cn: 法拉莫尔还说过，他确定猜测，是因为对方扮成我在他面前弹出的琴音，甚至扭曲得毫无掩饰……

say:35:1360211034:1.text: Alright, let's give it a try!
say:35:1360211034:1.male: Alright, let's give it a try!
say:35:1360211034:1.female: Alright, let's give it a try!

choice:34:0:1.text: How about you play a song?
choice:34:0:1.male: How about you play a song?
choice:34:0:1.female: How about you play a song?

choice:28:0:1.text: He must have left some clues.
choice:28:0:1.male: He must have left some clues.
choice:28:0:1.female: He must have left some clues.

say:37:1360211029:1.text: You mean this won't be the last mischief he pulls off? We might be able to find clues later.
say:37:1360211029:1.source_cn: 你是说，他还有可能继续作乱，而我们也有可能推测出线索？
say:37:1360211029:1.male: You mean this won't be the last mischief he pulls off? We might be able to find clues later.
say:37:1360211029:1.female: You mean this won't be the last mischief he pulls off? We might be able to find clues later.

say:38:1360211016:1.text: I can tell, no matter how well his disguise is. Years of dealing with dangerous creatures have honed my instincts for this.
say:38:1360211016:1.source_cn: 毕竟我经常要与危险的东西打交道，即使对方伪装得再好，直...

say:40:1360211006:1.text: Right on! The wind only conveys the truth, and my ears never fail to catch even the most subtle of emotions...
say:40:1360211006:1.source_cn: 那当然了！风从来不会欺瞒任何人，而我的耳朵总能捕捉到风...

say:40:1360211006:1.female: Right on! The wind only conveys the truth, and my ears never fail to catch even the most subtle of emotions...

say:41:1360211007:1.text: By the way, was that a compliment from you? It's making me blush!
say:41:1360211007:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿嘿，不过你居然这么夸我，搞得我都快不好意思了！
